_comment: Reviewed exemptions for scripts/quality/check-dsl-coverage.py. Each entry means: a human
decided this DSL feature is deliberately allowed to have zero corpus models exercising it, and
here is why. The key is the feature name exactly as check-dsl-coverage.py reports it.
docs/FINAL_OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md F8 was written specifically because NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max
(F3) already closed every zero-coverage feature the 2026-07-29 measurement found -- that
measurement scanned the full local corpus (AppGen/apps + NPDevSamples).
REG-69 (2026-07-29) briefly held 3 entries here (fragments, packs, step.updateConcept) for a
different failure mode -- real on a bare CI checkout where AppGen/apps is absent, not
zero-coverage locally. docs/FAIL_OPEN_PLAN.md R2 closed all three for real rather than leaving
them allowlisted: dsl-conformance-max gained an UpdateOrderLineQuantity flow (step.updateConcept),
a fully in-git fragments/auditLog.json ($ref-ed capability+binding, same shape as
AppGen/apps/npdev_split_model_sample_app's plugin/sendMail.json), and a fully in-git
packs/labeling/pack.json ($ref-ed concept pack, same mechanism as WmsOffice's identity/workspace
packs) -- neither `packs` nor `fragments` needed an out-of-tree asset; that was an untested
assumption, not a proven limit. All Gradle-validated (0 errors, 0 warnings). Empty again.
Add an entry here only for a genuine, reviewed exception with a REG id -- never pre-clear
speculatively; prefer adding a real example to dsl-conformance-max instead.
2026-08-21 roadmap close-out (PACK-8/PACK-10): packs.from and satelliteOf added as registered
detectors whose corpus witnesses are deliberately deferred (see each entry's why), matching the
repo's every-defect-must-be-real discipline -- they are tracked so a regression fails loudly.

packs.from.why: PACK-8 (PACK-ROADMAP card PK-5). packs[].from is the only remote-import syntax; the corpus cannot carry a live witness because generation must never fetch (the two-phase design), and a fixture needs a committed lock+cache or a vendored git+file:// repo wired into check-dsl-conformance-generates.py -- recorded in PACK-8 as deliberate non-trivial CI work, not a one-line sample. Detector registered so losing the syntax fails loudly; witness to be added with that CI work. Roadmap close-out 2026-08-21.

satelliteOf.why: PACK-10 (PACK-ROADMAP card PK-6). Live satelliteOf concepts exist only in NPDevSamples/probes/p6-satellite-extension, which find_models() excludes from DSL coverage by design (probes are fixtures, not evidence). Adding a satelliteOf concept with its anchor bond to dsl-conformance-max would ripple into schema/canonical-JSON validation; recorded as deliberately allowlisted so the detector is registered without co-opting a probe. Roadmap close-out 2026-08-21.
